purpose: Pre-unlock power + category-map re-audit for the AA applicability-model project (spec 2026-07-26-aa-applicability-model-design.md, section 3.4). Binds every section-10 release gate to the frozen Gate-3 locked-test group it will be certified on, with counts and zero-error floors. Counts-only projection of committed public metadata; NO locked sequences were loaded and the seal was NOT opened.
status: FINAL — Phase-0 counts-only audit; locked test remained sealed

provenance.method: counts-and-fingerprints only; no sequence access; locked_test.jsonl never read; unlock audit not created
provenance.confidence_bound: one-sided exact 95% upper (Clopper-Pearson); zero-error floor n is the smallest n with 1 - 0.05^(1/n) <= limit
provenance.guardband_scope: the 74/36 guardband floors bind ONLY the fresh selection + blind-LOCO subsets (spec 3.3/8.3); the locked seal is certified at the release floors 59/29 below

release_gates.note: TRG/TRD absent from the seal; TCR is certified via TRA+TRB only (spec 3.3). TRB alone (15) is below the 5% floor; TRA alone (75) is not.

vhh_substandalone.binding: VHH is binding ONLY through the combined group; all 19 VHH lineages must be evaluated (no attrition). VHH-specific FAR and its wide exact interval are reported descriptively.

release_gates.independent_unit: parent lineage (a parent is a false-accept if ANY of its expected-incomplete transforms is accepted); DO NOT count correlated transforms as independent observations

release_gates.gate: FRR on real complete human IGH
release_gates.note: Primary real-positive FRR is the direct-prepared repertoire subset (pos_igh_repertoire, 71 >= 29). humanized (13), design_human_framework (16), and pos_igh_structure (5) carry FROZEN labels, sit below the individual floor, and are reported descriptively per spec 3.3/10; report FRR both including and excluding anchor-prepared records.

release_gates.gate: FRR on simulator complete human IGH

absent_from_locked_test.consequence: The one-shot locked test certifies ONLY the near-domain / completeness / structural / positive threat model enumerated above. Generic non-antibody rejection, de-novo unsupported antibody-like designs, and arbitrary far-OOD (the open-set energy head's far-OOD efficacy) are NOT certifiable by the seal; they are evaluated descriptively on the fresh cohort only (spec 8.1, 10, 15).

audit_result.stop_condition: STOP_LOCKED_CATEGORY_MAP_MISMATCH is NOT triggered by the current section-10 gate set
audit_result.caveat: This audit binds the section-10 release gates as written. Before unlock, re-run against the SELECTED candidate's exact category mapping; any gate the candidate defines that lacks a present, floored locked category triggers STOP_LOCKED_CATEGORY_MAP_MISMATCH.
